purpose: Teach: 明け方/何せ/とっさ/一々/断じて/どっぷり/浸っ/ふしぎ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、明け方まで勉強してたろ?
lines.en: Riku — weren't you cramming all the way until dawn?
lines.style: Casual call-out, teasing edge. Direct eye contact. Light rhythm, like she's caught him red-handed and enjoying it slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、何せ運動会近いから頑張れ、桜
lines.en: The sports day's coming up fast, so you better give it your all.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact encouragement. Quick delivery, no fuss. The confidence of someone who doesn't need to perform sincerity to mean it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、とっさに走り出して凄かったぞ
lines.en: The way you just took off running like that — that was impressive.
lines.style: Genuine praise, slightly defensive about admitting it. Softer attack than her usual tone. A small acknowledgment held without making it a big thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト範囲、一々確認するなよ、桜
lines.en: Stop quizzing yourself on every single test detail, will you?
lines.style: Wry, knowing. Gentle underneath. The tone of someone who sees right through him and says it anyway, without malice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、断じてズルしないよな
lines.en: You never take shortcuts, do you? Not even a little.
lines.style: Statement more than question. Warm recognition underneath the casual phrasing. Like she's confirming something she already knows about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームにどっぷりはまってんな、桜
lines.en: You're spending way too much time buried in games right now.
lines.style: Dry observation with the smallest edge of concern underneath. Quick tempo. Not lecturing — just calling it like she sees it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お風呂に浸ってぼーっとしてんな
lines.en: You're just soaking in the bath, zoning out completely.
lines.style: Light teasing. Slower, observant rhythm — like she's watching him more than scolding him. Soft amusement in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト点、ふしぎな点数だな、桜
lines.en: Your test scores are weirdly all over the place, aren't they?
lines.style: Wry observation with genuine curiosity underneath. Pause before the final thought. Not accusatory — more like she's puzzling something out about him.
